storage.title: Storage
storage.description: Where {{app}} keeps its data, how much space it takes, and how to clean it up.

home.title: Data folder
home.description: Everything {{app}} keeps on this computer is in this folder. The library part can be moved below.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: One folder per skill. Also the Git repository that backup pushes.

database.title: Database
database.description: Deployments, projects, settings and activity. Rebuilt from the skill folders if lost.

history.title: Editor history
history.description: Earlier versions of files you saved in the editor, the last 20 per file.
history.clearEffect: Every earlier version of every file goes. Your skills and their current text stay.

cache.title: Download cache
cache.description: Copies of Git repositories kept to make installs and update checks faster.
cache.clearEffect: The next install or update check downloads its repository again. A download in progress is left alone.

logs.title: Logs
logs.description: What {{app}} did and what went wrong, for troubleshooting.
logs.clearEffect: Old logs are deleted and the current one is emptied.

cli.title: Command-line tool
cli.description: The loadout command your agents run. Published again each time the app starts.

app.title: App data
app.description: Window size, your GitHub sign-in (encrypted), interface preferences, drafts and the app's cache.
app.clearEffect: Only the app's cache is emptied. Your sign-in, preferences and drafts stay.

window.title: Interface
window.description: Kept in the app data folder for this computer only.

preferences.title: Interface preferences
preferences.description_one: Sidebar width and sections, grid or list views, editor layout. {{count}} saved.
preferences.description_other: Sidebar width and sections, grid or list views, editor layout. {{count}} saved.

drafts.title: Unsaved editor drafts
drafts.description_one: Text typed in the editor but never saved. {{count}} kept.
drafts.description_other: Text typed in the editor but never saved. {{count}} kept.

outside.title: Outside this folder
outside.description: {{app}} also writes to these places. Removing the data folder does not touch them, except where said.
outside.agents: Agent skills folders (such as ~/.claude/skills) get links or copies of your skills. Removing all data takes the links out; copies only when you ask.
outside.projects: Project folders get the skills and instruction files you add there. They are your project's files and are never removed.
outside.backup: Your backup repository, when backup is set up. It stays on its host.
outside.keychain: On macOS, the system keychain holds the key your GitHub sign-in is encrypted with. Removing all data deletes it.
outside.system: The operating system keeps a few small files of its own for every app, such as saved window state on macOS.

removeAll.title: Remove all data
removeAll.description: Delete everything {{app}} keeps on this computer and quit. Use this before uninstalling or to start over.
removeAll.deletes: The data folder {{path}} is deleted: every skill in the library, the database, editor history, logs, the command-line tool and the app's own data. This cannot be undone.
removeAll.links: Links to library skills in agent folders are removed first, because they would point at nothing. A library moved elsewhere is removed too.
removeAll.keeps: Project folders and your backup repository are left alone. {{app}} quits when it is done; opening it again starts fresh.
removeAll.copies: Also delete the skill copies {{app}} put into agent folders
